description: This file contains extension methods for grain objects in Orleans, providing utility functions such as obtaining grain references, grain IDs, and primary keys, as well as type casting and type checks related to grains.

classes.name: GrainExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to work with Orleans grains and grain references, including methods for obtaining references, IDs, primary keys, and type casting.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a GrainReference for the provided IAddressable grain, handling nulls and different implementations.

methods.name: AsReference<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Returns a strongly typed grain reference implementing TGrainInterface.

methods.name: Cast<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Returns a typed grain reference implementing TGrainInterface; an alias for AsReference<TGrainInterface>.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a grain reference cast to a specified interface type.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Returns a grain reference cast to a specified interface type; alias for AsReference with Type parameter.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainId associated with the given grain.

methods.name: GetWrongGrainTypeErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message when an unexpected grain type is encountered.

methods.name: IsPrimaryKeyBasedOnLong
methods.description: Checks whether the primary key of a grain is of type long.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyLong
methods.description: Extracts the long value from a grain primary key, with an optional extended key output.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyLong
methods.description: Extracts the long value from a grain primary key.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a Guid, with an extended key output.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a Guid.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyString
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a string.

methods.name: ThrowGrainNull
methods.description: Utility method to throw an ArgumentNullException when grain argument is null.
